## 1) AUB module sweep + select best
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
```
**Goal:** find module-level improvements and automatically promote the best.

**What to watch for in output:**
- Any candidate that improves **min** (especially tuning_min 0.43) without degrading lockbox.
- If it only improves mean but worsens min materially, treat it as risky unless your selection criteria explicitly prefer mean.

**If it selects a best:** confirm it writes an updated champion (or a promoted artifact) and note which module changed.

## 2) System-level candidate sweep
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
```
**Goal:** explore higher-level/system combinations that module-only search may miss.

**What to watch:**
- Whether any system candidate addresses the **worst-case** behavior (min).
- If a system candidate improves tuning but harms lockbox (or vice versa), that’s usually a sign of overfitting to one suite.

If runtime is tight, consider limiting/early-stopping to top N candidates if the tool supports it (not shown here, but worth checking `--help`).

## 3) Generate “next fix” plan
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
**Goal:** produce an actionable diagnosis/roadmap based on current registry + results.

This is especially useful if (a) no improvements are found, or (b) improvements are marginal and you need to target the outlier causing tuning_min ≈ 0.43.

---

## Suggested prioritization (given the metrics)
- Your **biggest leverage** is likely raising the **tuning_min** from ~0.43 (one or a few scenarios are failing badly).
- Lockbox looks more stable (min ~1.13), so avoid “fixes” that trade catastrophic tuning cases for lockbox regressions.

## If you paste one thing back here
Paste the tail of:
- the AUB autopilot run summary (best candidate + deltas), and
- any mention of which eval cases drove the low tuning_min (if surfaced anywhere)

…and I can help decide whether to accept the promoted candidate or adjust selection criteria to target worst-case robustness.
